headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson and the Cleveland Browns are developing a knack for coming up big in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson leads another game-winning drive, Szmyt hits 56-yard FG and Browns beat Steelers 27-24

headlines.description: — Sip some tea, score some touchdowns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tea time as Jonathan Taylor runs for 2 TDs and Colts beat Commanders 30-13 in London

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: — Drake Maye didn’t have to be perfect after his rough start to the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Maye overcomes his two turnovers with 3 TD passes in Patriots' 29-26 win over Bills

tuneInPrompt.title: Consecutive Completions
tuneInPrompt.caption: Josh Allen has 10 completions in a row.
tuneInPrompt.shortText: Josh Allen has 10 completions in a row.

events.name: New York Jets at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: — The Chicago Bears kept handing the ball to Kyle Monangai and the New York Jets had precious little time to respond.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Monangai scores 2 TDs as the Chicago Bears beat the New York Jets 23-12

headlines.description: — The Jaguars didn't have a nightmare finish in Cincinnati for the second straight year.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevor Lawrence finally gets 1st win over Bengals as Jaguars hold on for 22-17 victory

events.name: Arizona Cardinals at New York Giants

headlines.description: — Jameis Winston showed off the good, bad and ugly of his football career and it required another late defensive stand to get it done. It was far from a masterpiece, but the New York Giants will take it.
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston throws 3 TD passes and Banks' pick-6 seals Giants' 36-24 win over Cardinals

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: — Sean McVay had seen enough of a Rams team mired in a funk. Los Angeles' coach huddled the entire offense around him as the clock ticked down toward the end of the third quarter and his team down by 10.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams rally behind Stafford, Williams from 10 points down in 4th quarter to beat Eagles 24-20

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — An ugly win left the Green Bay Packers dissatisfied.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jordan Love throws 2 touchdown passes, Packers edge Buccaneers 17-14

headlines.description: — The Baltimore Ravens could have used a quiet, boring victory as a heavy favorite at home.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens beat Titans 24-18 but lose Lamar Jackson to ankle injury. Henry scores against his old team

headlines.description: — CeeDee Lamb shined in his first NFL game in the city he considers his second home to carry the Dallas Cowboys to a victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: CeeDee Lamb’s late TD caps a wild Cowboys rally to beat winless Texans 34-30

headlines.description: — Kyler Murray and the Minnesota Vikings ' offense would've appreciated a touchdown for their progress down the stretch, but there was only one way to truly secure this victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Unbeaten Vikings keep Dolphins winless with dominant defense, Reichard's kicks, Hockenson's catches

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders

headlines.description: — Patrick Mahomes said he loves playing in Allegiant Stadium, and it's no wonder, given his perfect record in one of the NFL's newer venues.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs beat the Raiders 30-27 to move to 4-0 behind Patrick Mahomes and Kenneth Walker III

headlines.description: — Once the San Francisco 49ers got going on offense, Brock Purdy and crew once again couldn't be stopped.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Purdy throws 2 TD passes to lead the undefeated 49ers past the Broncos 24-14

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: — The Seattle Seahawks got their rebound win, but it was far from perfect.
headlines.shortLinkText: Emanuel Wilson sparks Seahawks past Chargers 30-23, handing Los Angeles a fourth straight loss

headlines.description: — Carolina Panthers coach Dave Canales was a little worried after Bryce Young and Tetairoa McMillan had some issues connecting on passes in practice.
headlines.shortLinkText: Young, McMillan connect for 2 TDs to lead Panthers past Lions 32-26

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: — Bijan Robinson ensured there would be no punt to block this time — and the Atlanta Falcons were off and running.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bijan Robinson powers Falcons past Saints 45-24 on the 20th anniversary of the Superdome's reopening
